name: Amber & Linen
description: Closest to Lisenza's existing brand — warm, artisanal, intimate. Large product photography with generous whitespace, asymmetric text-image pairings.
typography: Bon Voyage for display headings (brand font), Inter for body text (clean, modern readability)
layout_style: Editorial warmth — large product photography with generous whitespace, asymmetric text-image pairings like P.F. Candle Co. Sections breathe with 80-100px vertical spacing. Products in a soft 2-column grid on desktop.

name: Maison Noire
description: Elevated luxury — high contrast, editorial sophistication inspired by Diptyque and Boy Smells. Full-bleed hero imagery, black section dividers, products on clean white with generous negative space. Editorial rhythm with alternating image-left/image-right sections.
typography: Bon Voyage for display headings (brand font), Libre Baskerville for secondary headings, Neuzeit Grotesk for body
layout_style: High-contrast minimal — full-bleed hero imagery, black section dividers, products on clean white with generous negative space. Diptyque-style editorial rhythm with alternating image-left/image-right sections. 100-120px section spacing.

name: Jardín Tropical
description: Fresh, modern, Dominican-inflected — lighter, more colorful, approachable. Airy grid with product carousel, generous padding, soft rounded corners on cards.
typography: Bon Voyage for display headings (brand font), Work Sans (light/regular) for body — clean, airy like Voluspa
layout_style: Airy grid — product carousel with horizontal scroll, generous padding (Voluspa-style). Soft rounded corners on cards. Light, breathable sections with 60-80px spacing. Full-width lifestyle imagery interspersed between product sections.
